specification.netscape: Conventional NETSCAPE2.0 application payload; application framing is specified by section 26, looping semantics are not defined by GIF89a.

collection.equality: exact complete observation equality, including PNG, SVG, SVG-derived PNG and RGBA
collection.capture: One opaque full-screen table image, no GCE or animation delay. Plain text precedes that image and is overwritten. NETSCAPE has only one table image; no animation timing claim.

authored_expectation_policy: Fixed-seed integer indices expanded directly through explicit palette; never derived from decode or adjusted to browser. Separate JS packed-byte audit is an author check; independent Rust checker belongs to parent.

stream.audit: separate JS table decoder equals authored indices; EOI and zero padding checked
